prerequisites: CSPC-207, CSPE-210 (Software Engineering, Software Development using UML and Agile Methodology)
description: The objectives of the course are to prepare students for learning different techniques of verification and validation of object oriented and web based software.

syllabus.title: Preliminaries
syllabus.body: Fundamentals of software testing, errors and testing, software quality, requirements, behavior and correctness, correctness versus reliability, testing and debugging, verification and validation, types of testing, testing process.

syllabus.title: Introduction to Testing and Software Verification
syllabus.body: Functional testing: boundary value analysis, equivalence class testing, decision table based testing, cause-effect graphing. Structural testing: control flow, data flow, slice based and mutation based testing. Software verification: SRS/SDD/source code/user document review, software project audit.

syllabus.title: Test Case Generation and Regression Testing
syllabus.body: Test case generation from requirements and use cases, validity checking, data validation strategies, database testing; test generation from finite state models; introduction to regression testing, test case selection methods, risk analysis, code coverage prioritization, test selection using execution trace and dynamic slicing.

syllabus.title: Object Oriented Testing and Test Generation from Combinatorial Designs
syllabus.body: Combinatorial designs, fault model, Latin squares, mutually orthogonal Latin squares, pairwise design; object oriented testing: path testing, state based testing, class testing.

outcomes: Describe techniques in the areas of software inspection, software testing and software validation.
Apply different techniques for verification of the software.
Generate test cases for validating object-oriented software.
textbooks: Yogesh Singh, Software Testing, Cambridge Publication, 2013.
Aditya P. Mathur, Foundations of Software Testing, Second edition, Pearson Education, 2013.
